messages.text:
Sorry about that. Faulty units go through RMA: fill in the intake form and we send you a return label, then it's up to 10 days after it reaches the warehouse. Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

One thing first, was the unit ever overclocked or modified? That voids the warranty.

Which miner is it, and what's it doing? If it's a dead PSU we can just send a new one, no return needed.
Good. If you get stuck on the form or the fault turns out to be something simpler, just say the word and I'll take a look.
Sounds good. Have a good one, and hope the replacement sorts it quickly.
